validation_scope.raw: Fresh raw ground beef (~75% lean), fresh raw beef trim (~75%), and beef carcass sampling sheets (spunbonded polyolefin sampling sheet) MODIFICATION JUNE 2022: leafy greens (200 g), hemp flower (10 g; ≤ 0.3% delta 9-THC)
matrices: beef carcass sampling sheets (spunbonded polyolefin sampling sheet) MODIFICATION JUNE 2022: leafy greens (200 g)

traceability.notes: AOAC-RI certificate PDFs bundle certification metadata AND validation-study performance data in one document (unlike NF-Validation's separate cert + summary-report). Inclusivity/exclusivity extraction is best-effort text mining (narrative counts where stated, else counted from per-strain table rows -- table rows wrapped across two PDF text lines can be undercounted). The presumptive-vs-confirmed / vs-reference-method POD comparison tables are not yet mined (table layout is not reliably recoverable from PDF text extraction). This parser has only been developed against 4 example certificates; broaden coverage once more are available.
